Bhai, maine latest bot.py check kiya ✅ code me koi hard-coded DOWN/PUT bias nahi hai.

CALL aur PUT dono ke rules mirror hain: EMA bullish/bearish, MACD, Bollinger, ADX/+DI/-DI, momentum, candle rejection aur volume dono directions ko same weights milte hain. Final signal bhi seedha bullish_points > bearish_points ho to CALL, warna valid bearish dominance par PUT banta hai.

Multi-timeframe level par bhi bot CALL aur PUT ki count separately karta hai; jis direction ke zyada valid TF agree karein wahi final hoti hai. Tie ho to signal reject hota hai.

Aur frontend bhi NO SIGNAL ko PUT me convert nahi kar raha—latest code usko null/reject karta hai.

Isliye agar abhi lagatar DOWN aa raha hai to do likely reasons hain: current scanned assets genuinely bearish trend me hain, ya Auto Scan highest-confluence pair pick kar raha hai aur us waqt strongest setups PUT side ke hain.

Main artificially CALL/PUT 50-50 nahi karunga, kyunki usse accuracy kharab hogi. Better fix ye hoga ke bot me Direction Diagnostic add karein: har scan ke baad dikhaye CALL candidates: X | PUT candidates: Y | NO TRADE: Z aur Top 3 me dono sides ka raw score dikhaye. Isse turant pata chalega market bearish hai ya actual bias issue hai.

Agar aap chaho to main latest files me ye direction-bias diagnostic + safeguard add karke replacement index.html + bot.py bana deta hoon.
